house.description: Hennepin County; recycling recovery facility appropriation modified.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Capital Investment

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; modifying an appropriation for a recycling recovery facility in Hennepin County; amending Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 3, subdivision 4.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 3, subdivision 4, is amended to read:

Subd. 4.
Hennepin County; [-Anaerobic Digester-][+ Recycling Recovery Facility +]

26,000,000

For a grant to Hennepin County to predesign, design, construct, furnish, and equip a [-new anaerobic digestion-][+ recycling recovery+] facility in the city of Brooklyn Park.[+ This project includes the demolition of the Hennepin County Sheriff's facility at the site to make room for the recycling recovery facility. +]

[-This appropriation is not available until Hennepin County submits a plan for the cessation of operations at the Hennepin Energy Recovery Center to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with primary jurisdiction over capital investment and environment and natural resources. -]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; modifying an appropriation for a recycling recovery facility in Hennepin County; amending Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 3, subdivision 4.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 3, subdivision 4, is amended to read:

Subd. 4.
Hennepin County; Recycling Recovery Facility

26,000,000

For a grant to Hennepin County to predesign, design, construct, furnish, and equip a recycling recovery facility in the city of Brooklyn Park. This project includes the demolition of the Hennepin County Sheriff's facility at the site to make room for the recycling recovery facility.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: This project includes the demolition of the Hennepin County Sheriff's facility at the site to make room for the recycling recovery facility.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
deletions: This appropriation is not available until Hennepin County submits a plan for the cessation of operations at the Hennepin Energy Recovery Center to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with primary jurisdiction over capital investment and environment and natural resources.
